gate.rule: R2 > 0.8 AND (RMSE < 20 ug/m3 OR nRMSE <= species_cap; default 0.12, PM10 = 0.25 per Option B, CO = 0.30 per 2026-09-20 amendment)
gate.nrmse_cap_rationale: Option B (user-approved 2026-09-18): PM10 relative bar 0.25 (dust-belt CAMS PM10 intrinsically ~19% volatile; exhaustive leak-free remediation record in docs/MODEL_VALIDATION.md); all other species keep nRMSE <= 0.12. Raw values reported beside every verdict.
gate.scope: all six species, per station; nRMSE clause = the species_gate convention in scripts/finetune_chronos2_delhi.py

protocol.truth: CAMS reanalysis at each station's own 0.4-deg grid cell (scoring only; never trained on)
protocol.grid: 0.4-degree cells, boundaries 0.4k+0.2 (empirically verified; 5 cells cover all 50 stations)
protocol.station_calibrations: NONE — no offsets, no sensor pairing, no post-holdout fitting of any kind
protocol.model: the six published fine-tuned Chronos-2 specialists (unchanged weights)

leakage_statement: Training: chronological split, target future never in inputs (published audit). This evaluation: per-cell truth series are holdout-only CAMS reanalysis; no station calibration is fit on any evaluation window; the IQAir single-hour offsets used by the serving station layer are deliberately excluded here because they are post-holdout data.
